issues: Performance/Architecture: _updateInfoPanel and _updateTooltip overwrite innerHTML every single frame. This causes massive layout thrashing and prevents text selection or sub-element interaction.
Memory Leak: window.addEventListener('keydown') is never removed. UI needs a destroy() method to clean up global listeners.
Acceptance Criteria: Using innerHTML to inject game strings (e.g., building names, error reasons) violates the 'no innerHTML with untrusted data' rule. Use textContent for dynamic strings.
Architecture: _updateStock and _updateObjectives lack dirty-checking. They perform DOM operations every frame/interval regardless of whether the underlying data changed.
Robustness: JSON.stringify(this.tool) is a slow and brittle way to handle tool state comparison in a hot loop.
Polish: The 'pixel font' requirement is poorly met; 'Courier New' is a standard monospace font, not a pixel-art font. Use a specific webfont or a more curated stack.
Logic: The speed button sync in togglePause() is inconsistent with the update() loop. Speed state should have a single source of truth and a reactive update.
UX: The tooltip for placement problems follows the mouse using raw clientX/Y without accounting for scroll or container offsets, leading to 'jumping' on different resolutions.
Code Quality: _initDOM is a 'mega-string'. Break into smaller functional components or use a template system to improve maintainability.
